methods.label: Model three fenced sides
methods.explanation: Let the side perpendicular to the wall have length \(x\). Then the side parallel to the wall has length \(24-2x\), and \(S=x(24-2x)=-2(x-6)^2+72\). The maximum is 72 when \(x=6\).
